message: 似顔絵は心を写す

name: Synn
message: 「They say no news is good news, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Holding down the fort is tough work too, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Better than running into trouble, I suppose...」

name: Ria
message: 「Then could I get you to help out just a tiny bit?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, if there's anything I can do around here.」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks!」
Students carrying sketchbooks came filing over one after another.

name: Ria
message: 「I suggested to everyone in the art club that drawing portraits would be better than selling silkscreens, and they went right along with it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hoho~」

name: Ria
message: 「So, you see. I want you to be a customer. You, Synn!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Making him act as a shill, huh... Just like Ria-chan, devious as ever despite being so cute.」

name: Ria
message: 「Since he's a \{Sakura|\s12\s12}, after all. Just kidding.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama isn't up to the task. Leave it to yours truly.」

name: Synn
message: 「You wouldn't even work as a crowd-pleasing mascot.」

name: Ria
message: 「If we make a sample with Synn first, customers will see it and come on over, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「A portrait of me? Uu, that's a little embarrassing~~」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll draw you super handsome, okay.\s04」
Even Ria-senpai was tightly gripping a pencil.

name: Synn
message: 「Were you in the art club, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nope, I'm not♪」
And yet she even had a sketchbook on hand.

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me you're going to draw too, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course\s04 I'm the one who suggested it, after all♪」
Ria-senpai really, badly wants to draw.

name: Paqy
message: 「That's why I'm saying, if you don't want to do it, yours truly will take your place!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I never said I wouldn't do it! F-Fine, I get it, let's do this!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch. Guess I'll just behave myself and be Ria-chan's chair or somethin'」

name: Ria
message: 「I've got a much more important role for you, Paa-chan, so look forward to it.\s07」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yahoo!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right! Only problem is, I don't have any cash on me to donate...」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't worry about it. I'll throw this one in on the house.\s04」
Prompted along, I take a seat on the folding pipe chair.

name: Ria
message: 「Now's your time to shine, Paa-chan.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Been waitin' for this!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What the hell is goin' on here!」

name: Ria
message: 「Give me a big smile, Paa-chan.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Okaaay.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「That's what I want to know! Why am I in a pose like this--」

name: Ria
message: 「Look sharp, Synn-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yessir!!」
Ria-senpai's request went something like this.
She wanted me to hug Paqy tightly and adorably against my chest. And also look cool while doing it. How does that even work?

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa~~! So cuuute!」

name: Shio
message: 「For a man, enduring shame is also a form of training. You have my heartfelt respect.」

name: Azel
message: 「How pathetic.」

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft. Prez, you look so lame!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I might as well slap my pride into a bread roll and eat it at this point...」

name: Ria
message: 「Amazing, Synn-kun. Thanks to you, we're a huge hit!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really?!」
Customers drawn in by our little exchange start streaming over toward the art club members.

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... Well, if it worked out, I'm glad.」

name: Ria
message: 「Just a little more, so keep making a gallant face, okay?\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「In the first place, does looking gallant while hugging a doll even work visually?」

name: Ria
message: 「I thought the unexpected contrast might be fun~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I see.」
Art is profound.

name: Ria
message: 「Just kidding\s07 Actually, I just wanted to draw your cute side too, Synn.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey now, no moving~」

name: Synn
message: 「Grrr!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee.」
Ria-senpai looks like she's having so much fun. It's kind of making me want to try it too.

name: Paqy
message: 「Aah... Thighs are the best.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy?」
Paqy's gaze is fixed on Ria-senpai's legs.
Thinking, 'What's the point of just staring at her legs--' I happened to glance over at that exact moment.
Ria-senpai uncrossed and recrossed her legs.
Her thighs jiggled with just the right amount of bounce. And that wasn't all. For just a split second, something was visible between her legs.
Something covered in black tights.
C-Could that be-wait, no, bad, bad!!

name: Synn
message: 「Eye poke!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's nothing!」
I need to think about something else, like the names of past prime ministers--.

name: Ria
message: 「Mm! All done♪ Good work.\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Haaah~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep, yep. I daresay this turned out quite nicely.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh~~. Mind if I take a look?」

name: Ria
message: 「Sure, here you go♪」
Beaming with a wide smile, she holds out the sketchbook.
I take it in my hands and am left speechless. What a villainous mug!!

name: Synn
message: 「Is this really how my face looks to you, Ria-senpai...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, it don't look anything like Synn-sama at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then that defeats the whole point of a portrait.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even so, she draws damn well as usual. Way to go, Ria-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's skilled, all right. Even if it doesn't look like me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She knows that likeness ain't everything.」

name: Ria
message: 「It gives off a cute, slightly bad-boy vibe, don't you think.」

name: Synn
message: 「Collaboration?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah!! A collaboration and a revolution.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's certainly revolutionary, but...」
Well, people don't necessarily need to tell I'm the model. They'd want a skilled artist to draw them, after all.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, shall we put this on display and wait for customers?」

name: Ria
message: 「It totally screams WANTED.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「That was the theme this time!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Now it's your turn next, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「This time, you're going to draw a portrait using me as the model, Synn-kun.」
Whoa, this is an opportunity I couldn't have asked for!!

name: Synn
message: 「I'm terrible at drawing, but please let me do it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh? You're super fired up, aren't you.\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Well~~. Looking at you just got my fingers itching, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't you mean twitching?」

name: Synn
message: 「Bwah!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, just kidding.\s04」
What makes Ria-senpai so amazing is that it's not entirely a joke.

name: Ria
message: 「So, what kind of pose should I do?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Anything's fine. Whatever you'd like, Synn-kun.\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「This is your chance, Synn-sama. Ask her for something you normally wouldn't be able to!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're right. It is a festival, after all. Then... a sexy pose!!」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Umm~~, what should I actually do, specifically?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, whatever you think is sexy, Senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't know something like that~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then a normal pose is fine, please.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's too soon to give up!! If you don't know, I'll teach you!!」
Paqy brought over a round serving tray.

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan. First, hold this with both hands.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then, rest your big boobs on the tray, Ria-chan. It takes a load off your shoulders too, killing two birds with one stone!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pafu!!」

name: Ria
message: 「You pervert, Paa-chan!! I can't do something that embarrassing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then, um. How about pretending to be a waitress with that tray.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...... if it's just that.」
Fidgeting shyly, she puts both hands behind her back and holds the tray.
She leans forward and gazes up at me.

name: Ria
message: 「L-Like this?」
Even without saying anything, she naturally ends up striking a sexy pose anyway.
Though it has nothing to do with the portrait at all.

name: Ria
message: 「I knew it, this is way too embarrassing~~」

name: Synn
message: 「You were doing whatever you wanted just a moment ago, so you'll just have to put up with this much.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's a senpai's privilege, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「A real senpai wouldn't act so selfish.」

name: Ria
message: 「Uu~~. You're so mean, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, come on, models aren't supposed to move.」

name: Ria
message: 「Mean, mean, mean!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Someone is gazing at the picture Senpai drew.

name: Ria
message: 「Welcome to Ryuusei Academy. Please enjoy your visit.」
What an incredible sudden change.

name: Man
message: 「Is this a portrait-no, perhaps a self-portrait?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Man
message: 「My, my, how wonderful. It overflows with boldness and charm, enough to make one wonder whether the subject is male or female.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm a guy, though.\s01」

name: Man
message: 「Such artistic skill and sensibility. Meeting someone who possesses both is like finding a four-leaf clover on a path taken on a whim.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you... talking about me?」

name: Man
message: 「Is that not your face depicted right here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh... y-yes, it is, but... it actually looks like me to you?」

name: Man
message: 「Could it be that you happen to have a twin brother?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now that's a new twist.」

name: Ria
message: 「So you had an older brother.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd be the most surprised if I did! More importantly, why are you treating me like the younger one?!」
In any case, this person recognized Ria-senpai's drawing as a portrait of me without any explanation whatsoever.

name: Synn
message: 「I hate to disappoint you, but I'm not the one with that talent.」

name: Man
message: 「Could it be that talking plushie?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's the Great Sage Paqy to you!」

name: Man
message: 「Even if it is a talking plushie, I hardly think it could have drawn this picture.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, don't just jump to conclusions!!」

name: Man
message: 「In that case, that leaves...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. It was drawn by Ria Kujou here.」

name: Ria
message: 「Nice to meet you. I'm glad to hear you like it ♪」

name: Man
message: 「They say heaven does not bestow two gifts upon one person, yet that saying holds no meaning before someone like you.」

name: Man
message: 「This rare artistic talent, and on top of that, beauty that anyone would envy.」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, that's not true at all...\s03」

name: Man
message: 「No need to be so modest. You ought to puff out your chest with pride.」
Senpai looks pretty happy to be praised, too.

name: Man
message: 「In fact, it would be no exaggeration to say you've been bestowed with three gifts.」
Where's the third one, I wonder? Maybe the fact that she's holding Japanese sweets.

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, what a shady bastard.」

name: Synn
message: 「How can you say that about a customer?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I especially can't stand that mug of his!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I get it. You're just jealous, aren't you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's tellin' her to puff out her chest!! He means show off your boobs, ya know!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, you're overthinking it.」
Wait a second... Two gifts turning into three--don't tell me...

name: Ria
message: 「Would you care for a portrait?」

name: Man
message: 「I'm truly grateful for the kind invitation. However, I've only just begun my stroll.」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that so? Please look around and enjoy yourself♪」

name: Man
message: 「Well... the thing is, I'm rather unfamiliar with the academy's layout.」

name: Ria
message: 「Could this be your first time visiting?」

name: Man
message: 「Yes, I'm embarrassed to admit. So... if it wouldn't be too much trouble, might I ask you to show me around?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes, of course I will♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold it right there!!」

name: Man
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't go getting close to my Ria!!」

name: Man
message: 「Treating a lady like an object with possessive pronouns is hardly admirable.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Quit acting all high and mighty!? If you got a problem, I'll take you on!! Shoo! Shoo, shoo!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Easy, easy. Calm down, Paqy.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm terribly sorry. He's a foul-mouthed plushie. I'll give him a proper talking-to.」

name: Man
message: 「And you would be this plushie's owner, then.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. My name is Synn Sakura, the Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you'd like, I can show you around.」

name: Man
message: 「I am deeply grateful, however, the young lady over there has already offered to guide me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, right. Having the Student Council President show you around would be much better. Well then, I'll take over watching the booth~」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry about that. Shall we get going, then?」

name: Man
message: 「Conversing with fair maidens... It is akin to a fresh, sweet fruit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Man
message: 「Yet that sweetness is all too fleeting, and so very fragile. I cannot help but cherish those precious moments beyond all else.」

name: Synn
message: 「In other words, you don't want to walk around with me.」

name: Man
message: 「Spot on.」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's finally shown his true colors!! This guy's just a sleazy pickup artist!!」

name: Ria
message: 「H... Hit on?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's when a guy calls out to a girl and takes her somewhere to hang out.」

name: Ria
message: 「I know at least that much!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even the great me wants to hang out with Ria-chan!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Your true nature is showing too, Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The same goes for you too, Synn-sama, doesn't it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Me!? I... well...」

name: Man
message: 「Then, how about this? We shall have her choose whom she wishes to accompany.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehh!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bring it on!! Let's settle this once and for all!!」

name: Man
message: 「My fair lady, is that acceptable to you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... u-yes.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai!? Are you sure about saying something like that!!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's fine. Leave it to me.」
I-Is it really going to be fine...?
However, even if Paqy has no chance, this guy... actually has pretty good features.
Could it be that Senpai fell in love at first sight or something like that!?
Grrr... Thinking about it like that is kinda making my heart pound.

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright, we'll go on 'ready, set', got it?」

name: Man
message: 「I have loved you since twelve thousand years ago!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey!! That's a head start!!」

name: Man
message: 「When speaking of love, not even a single moment's delay can be afforded.」
Senpai is fidgeting with her cheeks dyed red.
C-Could this be... no way, right!?

name: Ria
message: 「U-Umm~~」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sorry!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Serves you right.」

name: Man
message: 「...I see. So that's how it is.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like the great me wins. Come on, Ria-chan. Let's set off for paradise.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sorry to you too, Paa-chan!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wh-What the Panama!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, does that mean--」

name: Man
message: 「You never had any intention of choosing from the very beginning.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha... Whaaat. So that's what was going on~~」

name: Man
message: 「If that was how you felt, wasn't there no need to go along with this proposal in the first place?」

name: Ria
message: 「I thought you wouldn't accept it unless I told you clearly.」

name: Man
message: 「Spoken like the woman who captured my heart. However, being told so bluntly leaves me with no room to argue.」

name: Ria
message: 「I've never been hit on before, so I didn't really know what to do, um...」

name: Man
message: 「I am at fault for troubling you. Please keep that lovely smile on your face.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm really sorry.」

name: Man
message: 「Well... if there had been one more participant, the outcome might have been different, perhaps.」

name: Man
message: 「For now, let's just call it... an unknown truth.」
What a mysterious guy.

name: Man
message: 「Now then, I shall return to my journey in search of new romance. Excuse me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Wait a second, please.」

name: Man
message: 「Is there something else?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm terribly sorry about this, but hitting on people inside the academy might bother the other guests, so...」

name: Man
message: 「Please do not worry. Causing trouble is out of the question. I am merely endeavoring to spend a meaningful time with a lovely lady.」

name: Synn
message: 「That might be true, but there are people who wouldn't see it that way...」

name: Man
message: 「I appreciate the advice. However, the greater the obstacle, the fiercer the flames of love burn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... Blackuma-san.」

name: Man
message: 「Well, well. Such round, expressive eyes and enchanting hips. A moment conversing with you is akin to savoring the finest sweets.」

name: Ria
message: 「We have a sweet shop ready for you at Prier.\s04」
However, he picked the wrong person to hit on.

name: Misa
message: 「Hehehe... You're going to come with me for a bit.」

name: Man
message: 「Hahaha, to be invited instead is quite unexpected. You are rather assertive, aren't you? Still, that too is charming.」
He's going to get dragged straight outside the school gates...

name: Synn
message: 「I'm counting on you, Mr. Security Guard.」

name: Man
message: 「Security guard...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Take this guy too as a bonus.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey!! Why the hell am I getting dragged in too!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kuma~~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Whew~~ That surprised me.」

name: Synn
message: 「For a moment there, I had no idea what was going to happen.」

name: Ria
message: 「What was going to happen? It's not break time yet, so I couldn't have gone along with a pickup anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Does that mean if it were break time, you might have gone with him?」

name: Ria
message: 「No way, no way.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Of course not! That's Ria-senpai for you!」

name: Ria
message: 「I~ see~. So that's what that sigh earlier was all about.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, you thought I was the kind of person who'd get hit on by a total stranger and abandon my post... didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wasn't thinking that far!!」

name: Ria
message: 「So you were thinking it a little?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!」

name: Ria
message: 「What a shock~ To think you saw me like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Senpai, you were getting hit on by a handsome guy, and... you didn't even seem all that opposed to the compliments.」

name: Synn
message: 「But if he dragged you off somewhere and something awful happened to you, I'd...」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't need to worry so much, I'm fine~」

name: Synn
message: 「I still worry. You're too trusting and kind, Senpai--」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「And you can be surprisingly naive about the world.」

name: Synn
message: 「You never know what could happen, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nothing like that would eeeever happen!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because I'm your senpai.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's hardly a reason...」

name: Ria
message: 「What's with you, huh?! You were just standing there watching in silence anyway~~」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the one who told me to leave it to you, Senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「In moments like that, you're supposed to ignore what your senpai says!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's completely unreasonable...」

name: Ria
message: 「Got it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Understood! In return, please don't get too friendly with strange men either, Ria-senpai. It makes me worry.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Did it really bother you that much seeing me get along with another guy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Ria
message: 「I get it! You were getting jealous, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「I am not jealous!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Nfufu\s04 I see~. Sorry, sorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you that's not it!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Thanks for worrying about me.」
Being told that so seriously all of a sudden throws me off.

name: Ria
message: 「Still, you shouldn't underestimate your senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes... I'll keep that in mind.」
Geez, Ria-senpai really is hard to get a read on...
